objects.name: Detection technique coverage: github-enterprise-modify-audit-log-event-stream
objects.description: The following analytic detects when a user modifies or disables audit log event streaming in GitHub Enterprise. The detection monitors GitHub Enterprise audit logs for configuration changes that affect the audit log streaming functionality, which is used to send audit events to security monitoring platforms. This behavior could indicate an attacker attempting to prevent their malicious activities from being logged and detected by tampering with the audit trail. For a SOC, identifying modificatio
